dedupe_keys.name: ecowheataly calibration dataset for an agent based model of italian durum wheat farms

description: This dataset calibrates an agent-based model of Italian durum wheat production, built in the Ecowheataly project on policies for sustainable wheat production, funded by Next Generation EU through the Italian PRIN 2022 call. The Zenodo record says a profit-maximising farm model is parameterised from RICA farm accounting microdata and the 2020 ISTAT agricultural census so that a population of heterogeneous farms reproduces yields, input intensity and farm size patterns, and it provides province-level census distribution parameters, estimation results, R code and a technical report. It was published in June 2026 (version 1.0.0) by researchers at the Italian National Research Council and the University of Chieti-Pescara under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download, about 16 MB. Coverage is Italy by province. Caveats: parameters are estimates, and the underlying microdata are not included. For simulation it gives calibrated farm agents to test policy, price and climate shocks on wheat supply. Related catalogue records include the UK Farm Business Survey and the FLAPS farm location and production simulator.
